transcript.text: Monkey! You useless, flea-bitten ape! The horse is gone, the scripture-bags are gone, and the Master is weeping! You said you'd secure it before you left! Tripitaka is going to blame me, I just know it!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Ease your temper, Pigsy! I'll fetch the horse and the bags before nightfall. Tripitaka will not hold you to account for this. I shall retrieve all, and you'll see.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Fetch them? How? You were off chasing clouds and showing off your somersaults while I was guarding the camp! Now the Master is sitting there muttering sutras and sniffling, and it's my head on the chopping block!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer

transcript.speaker: antagonist
